Name: Not Enough Flor Portraits
Author: TheBsheepX67
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
I really like Flor, so I also drewed a set of portraits of her.
The mod will replace the portraits and seasonal Outfits (need RSV Seasonal Outfits!) for Flor, as well as the Wedding Reception images.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Just extract the zip file and then throw it into your Mods folder.

If you really want, there is a folder inside the zip called [i]Overwrite version here.[/i] Copy things in it and paste into your Mods folder to install it by overwriting.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- SMAPI
- content patcher
- Ridgeside Village
- RSV Seasonal Outfits(optional)

[b]BUGS?[/b]
This is my first time making a mod. If any problems occur, I'm very sorry and please let me know.

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Massive thanks to Rafseazz and the Ridgeside Village team for the amazing mod. Your characters and stories inspired me to create this portrait pack. Also to the whole Stardew modding community and you who readying this.
